why: Hardware track, can run alongside firmware: the back cup fits (15) but nothing holds the glass until a front closes onto it. Starts with measuring what fouled v1, not remodelling.
Cheap win once 24 is in: both chips already answer on I2C (0x51 RTC, 0x6b IMU). The RTC keeps time across power cycles; the IMU can drive raise-to-wake later.

Blocked on a cell: do it as soon as one is connected. The battery path is the reason the power firmware exists and none of it has run on a cell yet; a wrong latch means a watch that dies when unplugged.
